column1: # 1.21.5: from<TAB>to (plain type, member:, re:) -- see prepare-sources.py
# NBT getters whose KEY is a variable (the shared 1.21.5 rows only take a string literal or CONSTANT, because a byte-offset
# read like ByteBuffer.getInt(at) looks the same). The receivers below are this fork's own tags/lists, named by what the
# compiler reported -- a new one shows up as an Optional<...> error, not silently.
re:\b(bansTag|data|factionsTag|relTag|seenMap|raiders|list|memberList)\.getInt\((\w+)\)
re:\b(bansTag|data|factionsTag|relTag|seenMap|raiders|list|memberList)\.getString\((\w+)\)
re:\b(bansTag|data|factionsTag|relTag|seenMap|raiders|list|memberList)\.getCompound\((\w+)\)
re:\b(bansTag|data|factionsTag|relTag|seenMap|raiders|list|memberList)\.getList\(([\w.()]+),\s*Tag\.TAG_\w+\)
# 1.21.5: LivingEntity.lastHurtByPlayerTime is lastHurtByPlayerMemoryTime and setLastHurtByPlayer(player, ticks) is public
# (the 1.21.1 comment about it writing tickCount no longer holds: it now writes the 100-tick memory directly)
re:entity\.lastHurtByPlayer = credit;\s*entity\.lastHurtByPlayerTime = 100;
# 1.21.5: lerpSteps/lerpX/... and Minecart.lerpTo became an InterpolationHandler; cancelling it is "lerpSteps = 0"
re:(?s)if \(entity instanceof LivingEntity\) \{\s*LivingEntity livingEntity = \(LivingEntity\) entity;\s*livingEntity\.lerpSteps = 0;.*?minecart\.lerpTo\([^;]*\);\s*\}
# HealthDataflowAnalyzer's duality table registers CompoundTag.getFloat/getInt/getLong/getDouble(String) as identity
# calls (key owner#name#desc). Since 1.21.5 those return Optional and the primitive getters are getXxxOr(String, prim)
# (javap 1.21.5 and 1.21.8 CompoundTag: getFloatOr (Ljava/lang/String;F)F, getIntOr (Ljava/lang/String;I)I,
# getLongOr (Ljava/lang/String;J)J, getDoubleOr (Ljava/lang/String;D)D), so the 1.21.1 keys match no call a mod
# compiled for 1.21.5+ makes and an NBT-held health read is reported "no inverse" and harvested as a dead-end root
# instead. getXxxOr(k, 0) is exactly 1.21.1's getXxx(k) (0 when absent). Each row matches the authors' two copies.
#!exhaustive  # live on 1.21.5-1.21.8; dead on 1.21.10+, where HealthDataflowAnalyzer is an overlay
re:registerIdentityCall\("net/minecraft/nbt/CompoundTag", "getFloat", "\(Ljava/lang/String;\)F"\)
re:registerIdentityCall\("net/minecraft/nbt/CompoundTag", "getInt", "\(Ljava/lang/String;\)I"\)
re:registerIdentityCall\("net/minecraft/nbt/CompoundTag", "getLong", "\(Ljava/lang/String;\)J"\)
re:registerIdentityCall\("net/minecraft/nbt/CompoundTag", "getDouble", "\(Ljava/lang/String;\)D"\)
#!strict
